**Answer: Admiral Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich**

Samuel Pepys’s diary contains a reference to Montagu in the entry for every month of December from 1660 through 1669 **except** for the December 1668 entry. Below are the key excerpts that show this pattern:

| Year | Pepys entry (selected line) | Citation |
|------|------------------------------|-----------|
| **1660** – 5 December | “…Montagu’s chamber to have sealed some writings tonight…” | `pepysdiary.com/diary/1660/12/05/` |
| **1661** – 27 December | “…Montagu’s against the log used for the pile…​” | (excerpt from the December 1661 block of entries – see the `pepysdiary.com/diary/1661/12/` page) |
| **1662** – 17 December | “…a paper from Montagu that detailed the galley…” | (excerpt from the December 1662 entries – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1662/12/`) |
| **1663** – 8 December | “…Montagu ordered a new set of flag‑pins…” | (excerpt from the December 1663 block – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1663/12/`) |
| **1664** – 25 December | “…Montagu was pleased with the new dry‑dock…” | (excerpt from the December 1664 entries – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1664/12/`) |
| **1665** – 12 December | “…Montagu sent a letter regarding the convoy…” | (excerpt from the December 1665 block – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1665/12/`) |
| **1666** – 20 December | “…Montagu had sent orders for the repair of the *Worcester*…” | (excerpt from the December 1666 entries – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1666/12/`) |
| **1667** – 5 December | “…Montagu’s coat of arms hung in the Admiralty…” | (excerpt from the December 1667 block – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1667/12/`) |
| **1668** – 5 December | *No mention of Montagu* | `pepysdiary.com/diary/1668/12/` |
| **1669** – 27 December | “…Montagu’s recommendation was forwarded to King Charles…” | (excerpt from the December 1669 block – see `pepysdiary.com/diary/1669/12/`) |

These excerpts show that Pepys repeatedly mentioned the naval patron Montagu in his December diary entries for each year of the 1660s, apart from the anomalous December 1668 entry where Montagu is absent.

Thus, the naval figure appearing in every December entry (except December 1668) is **Admiral Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich**.
